name: split-screen-compare
title: Split Screen Compare
description: Two columns, Kami against Biasanya. Rows tick in on our side with a drawn check and cross out on theirs, staggered. Each row is one line of the rows variable: our text, then theirs.
useWhen: Why a small shop is better than the usual alternative: fresher, cheaper, faster, with a guarantee.
Any versus list of 3 to 5 points.
avoidWhen: A before and after of one thing: use before-after-wipe.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Line above the columns. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Rows
variables.description: One per line, up to 6: our text|their text. With no | the same text is used on both sides.
variables.default:
Bahan segar tiap hari|Stok seminggu sekali
Tanpa pengawet buatan|Memakai pengawet
Dikemas saat dipesan|Dikemas sehari sebelumnya
Garansi uang kembali|Tanpa garansi

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: Checks and the outline of our column: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
